title: Sharing Unity Catalog agent skills with OpenSharing and Databricks Marketplace is now generally available
body: Providers can add Unity Catalog agent skills to OpenSharing shares and Databricks Marketplace listings, and Databricks recipients can use them. In some accounts, an account admin must turn on the **Agent Skill Sharing** preview. Sharing and using skills also requires the **Enhanced Unity AI Gateway** preview, which is in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). See [Add agent skills to a share](/aws/en/opensharing/create-share#skills) and [Create a Marketplace listing](/aws/en/marketplace/create-listing).
